source: NVIDIA kimodo-soma-rp-v1.1, 100 denoising steps, generated offline
frame: Kimodo SOMA frame: y up, metres; every block starts with its root at x = z = 0 facing +z
rotations: rotations[first:first + frames] are local xyzw rotations of the 30 joints below, in that order

mirror.rotation: (x, y, z, w) -> (x, -y, -z, w), then swap each pair

chaining: a block may follow another when its start equals the other's next; a loop repeats itself, each cycle placed at travel (x, z, turn) from the previous one; start {'hub': h} follows any block whose next is {'hub': h}; next null means hold the last frame
